description: Read the newest on-chain movements of tokenized stocks: each mint, burn and transfer with its time, stock, token and tokenizer, chain, shares, dollar value at the stored day-close price, both sides as a label or a shortened address, and the transaction hash. Give a stock, chain or tokenizer to narrow it, a minimum dollar value, or the number of rows to read.
name: get_recent_movements
title: Get recent movements
